releaseNote:
修复 Windows 下中文文件通过右上角编译运行时，因编译与运行环境差异或程序占用导致失败的问题。修复首次配置时工具链下载重试后流程可能无法继续的问题。

Fix compilation and execution failures for Chinese-named files on Windows caused by environment differences or a running executable when using the top-right Compile and Run button. Fix first-run setup sometimes getting stuck after retrying a toolchain download.
